title: L0: the list offers generate, with what it needs
kicker: A preview of HEART · 3 of 5 · HEART L0
html:
L0: the list offers generate, with what it needs

# GET /clientcertificates
# 200 OK, ETag: "seq-7.hsf.L0", Cache-Control: no-cache
_links:
  self:
    href: /clientcertificates
  curies:
    - name: clientcertificate
      href: /profiles/clientcertificate#{rel}
      templated: true
_embedded:
  item:
    - clientCertificateId: xmbiqp
      description: test-client-cert-2
      expirationDate: 2016-12-07T18:02:16Z
      _links:
        self:
          href: /clientcertificates/xmbiqp
      _forms:
        clientcertificate:update: {…}
        clientcertificate:delete: {…}
_forms:
  clientcertificate:generate:
    title: Generate a client certificate
    _links:
      target:
        href: /clientcertificates
    method: POST
    contentType: application/json
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        description:
          type: string
        tags:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {type: string}
  clientcertificate:by-id:
    title: Find a certificate by its id
    _links:
      target:
        href: /clientcertificates/{clientcertificate_id}
        templated: true
    method: GET
    schema:
      type: object
      required: [clientcertificate_id]
      properties:
        clientcertificate_id: {type: string}

MOCKUP Today L0 L1 L2 The list carries its own acts, and each item carries its own.
say: Mockup. The list of certificates at L0. generate becomes a form: POST, JSON, and the two fields AWS's GenerateClientCertificate takes, description and tags. by-id becomes a search-like form whose one field fills the template. Each certificate is embedded with its own forms, as on the previous slide.
